description: This pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," visually represents the proportional distribution of token routing within the Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Model framework. The chart is divided into three distinct segments: a large, dominant green section labeled "LOCAL" occupying 94.5% of the total; a smaller red section labeled "LLM" accounting for 3.9%; and a very narrow blue section labeled "EDGE_P2P" representing 1.6%. The chart includes percentage labels directly on each corresponding slice, and while there is no explicit legend, the labels are positioned adjacent to their respective colored segments, allowing for direct association. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with the "LOCAL" slice occupying the majority of the pie, followed by "LLM," and then "EDGE_P2P" as the smallest segment.
